title: give
description: Gives an item to a player.

player.title: player
player.description: A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.

itemname.title: itemName
itemname.description: An `enum` of the type of item to give.

amount.title: amount
amount.description: Amount to give to player. Default: `1`.

data.title: data
data.description: Optional. Fireworks related `data` required to give a firework type item.

components.title: components
components.description: Optional. Specify if the item has components to call required component events.
